en-2.reason: Verse 1 ends with "Head, shoulders, knees and toes / Knees and toes" sung higher (B4-C5, 27.4-30.3 s); every transcript skipped Verse 2 line 2 (35.3-38.1 s), so the identical lines let Verse 2 slide one line early. Boundary placed in the 1.1 s silence after 30.3 s. Lines 1 and 2 are pinned to the two sung stretches (31.4-34.3 s, 35.3-38.1 s) so the one transcribed copy is matched to line 1.
